segments.text: You want to park at the supermarket. But the queue isn't moving. At all.
Because at the front, there's a giant snail. And her house is too tall for the height barrier. What do you do?
Big mistake. Snails are shy. She jumps right out of her house, and it lands on your car.
Now you're the one who's too tall. And without her house, the snail slides under the barrier, and takes the last space.
Here's how you do it properly.
Snails love rain. So you turn on your windscreen washers. Full power.
She's so happy, she does a little dance. Then she lays her house down flat.
One metre ninety-nine. She slides under the barrier, with a millimetre to spare.
And as a thank-you, she leaves you a shiny slime trail. Straight into the last space.
You glide in, sideways. Whee! Perfect parking.
Next exam question: the traffic light is an owl. Follow, so you don't miss it.
